extracted_picks.speaker: Simon Hunter
extracted_picks.rationale: Chad did not include him in his top 10 list, which historically means he will win MVP. Every year Chad leaves him off, the Eagles make the Super Bowl.

extracted_picks.speaker: Rich Hribar
extracted_picks.rationale: The marriage of his elite talent with a Shanahan system coordinator historically leads to MVP-level production.

analysis_notes.summary: Rich Hribar defends Brock Purdy at #10, stating his off-script playmaking is the best Kyle Shanahan has had since RG3, despite injuries and offensive roster turnover.
analysis_notes.speaker: Rich Hribar
analysis_notes.quote: He creates so much more off-script than any guy Shanahan has had since RG3.

analysis_notes.summary: Rich Hribar has Drake Maye at #7, expecting a major leap with improvements to the Patriots' offensive line and weapons (AJ Brown, Romeo Doubs, Jared Wilson).
analysis_notes.speaker: Rich Hribar
analysis_notes.quote: Drake Maye, a guy that had that year 2... I think he's going to continue to propel forward.

analysis_notes.summary: Rich Hribar notes Jalen Hurts faces scheme changes under Sean Mannion/Kellen Moore, lacking anticipation and under-center experience, but Saquon Barkley's presence will help.
analysis_notes.speaker: Rich Hribar
analysis_notes.quote: Is he going to gel with this Sean Mannion system?... but they've got Saquon Barkley.

analysis_notes.topic: Lack of weapons and offensive stagnation
analysis_notes.summary: Rich Hribar has Mahomes at #5, questioning if we are just chasing his past cachet given a mediocre offensive supporting cast and a heavy defensive focus.
analysis_notes.speaker: Rich Hribar
analysis_notes.quote: Are we going to keep chasing the cachet of Patrick Mahomes' past to peak Tyreek Hill and apex Travis Kelce?

analysis_notes.summary: Simon and Rich discuss Baker Mayfield at #8, pointing to his toughness playing through injuries last year and the beneficial hiring of OC Liam Coen/Zach Robinson.
analysis_notes.speaker: Rich Hribar
analysis_notes.quote: I think Baker's actually going to have a really strong year.

quote_timestamps.speaker: Simon Hunter
quote_timestamps.quote: People, go get your MVP bets on Hurts while you can. Chad did not live in on his top 10 list, and we know when Chad doesn't put you in his top 10 list, you win MVP.

quote_timestamps.speaker: Rich Hribar
quote_timestamps.quote: I think he's in contention for MVP this year.
